A_7_1.title: Physical Security Perimeters
A_7_1.description: Define and implement physical security perimeters to protect sensitive areas containing information and processing facilities.

A_7_2.title: Physical Entry
A_7_2.description: Protect secure areas with appropriate entry controls to ensure only authorized persons can gain access.

A_7_3.title: Securing Offices, Rooms and Facilities
A_7_3.description: Apply physical security to offices, rooms, and facilities proportionate to the sensitivity of the information processed there.

A_7_4.title: Physical Security Monitoring
A_7_4.description: Monitor premises for unauthorized physical access using alarms, CCTV, guards, or other appropriate means.

A_7_5.title: Protecting Against Physical and Environmental Threats
A_7_5.description: Protect against physical and environmental threats such as fire, flood, earthquake, and deliberate damage.

A_7_6.title: Working in Secure Areas
A_7_6.description: Define and apply procedures for working in secure areas to prevent unauthorized access, photography, or data exfiltration.

A_7_7.title: Clear Desk and Clear Screen
A_7_7.description: Apply a clear desk policy for papers and removable media, and a clear screen policy for information processing facilities.

A_7_8.title: Equipment Siting and Protection
A_7_8.description: Site and protect equipment to reduce risks from environmental threats, unauthorized access, and interference.

A_7_9.title: Security of Assets Off-Premises
A_7_9.description: Apply controls to assets taken off-premises, proportionate to the risks of working outside the organization's premises.

A_7_10.title: Storage Media
A_7_10.description: Manage storage media throughout its lifecycle: acquisition, use, transportation, disposal, and sanitization.

A_7_11.title: Supporting Utilities
A_7_11.description: Protect information processing facilities from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.

A_7_12.title: Cabling Security
A_7_12.description: Protect power and telecommunications cabling from interception, interference, or damage.

A_7_13.title: Equipment Maintenance
A_7_13.description: Maintain equipment correctly to ensure continued availability and integrity of information processing facilities.

A_7_14.title: Secure Disposal or Re-Use of Equipment
A_7_14.description: Verify that all sensitive data and licensed software has been removed or overwritten prior to disposal or re-use of equipment.
